title: Object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and a translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw the first loop by creating the first line from the origin to the coordinates zero point zero two six eight, zero point zero two six eight. Continue with the second line from these coordinates to zero point zero two six eight, zero point zero six seven. Draw the third line from here to zero, zero point zero six seven, and complete the loop with the fourth line back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of zero point zero six seven. Transform this scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with the same Euler angles and translating it using the same vector. Extrude the transformed sketch zero point seven five units along its normal direction without extending it in the opposite direction. Use the extruded shape to create a new solid body. The dimensions of the final object are zero point zero two six seven eight five seven one four two eight five seven one four two eight eight units in length, zero point zero six six nine six four two eight five seven one four two eight five seven one units in width, and zero point seven five units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0268, 0.0268) \
     .lineTo(0.0268, 0.067) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.067) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90, 0, -90) and the translation vector is (0, 0, 0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Long bar with a wedge (knife-edge) cross-section tapering to a point at the bottom
r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([
        (0.0, 0.0670),   # top-left (y, z)
        (0.0268, 0.0670),# top-right
        (0.0, 0.0),      # bottom point (sharp edge)
    ])
    .close()
    .extrude(0.7500)
)
